candidates.sourceText: When using an Item with the DOUBLE Tag, Adventurers may choose which side they would like to equip following the rules and limitations of any other Weapon. When performing a Re-Equip Action, players may Re-Equip Items with the DOUBLE Tag as if it were two different cards. This means that they can switch their double-sided Item to the opposite side.
candidates.proposalText: Com um Item com Tag DOUBLE, o Aventureiro escolhe qual lado equipar, seguindo as regras e limitações de qualquer outra Arma. Na Ação de Reequipar, jogadores podem tratar Itens com Tag DOUBLE como se fossem duas cartas distintas. Assim, podem equipar o Item de duas faces com o lado oposto voltado para cima.

candidates.sourceText: • Item Upgrades grant 5 extra Gold per Item Upgrade equipped. Item Upgrades cannot be sold without also selling the Item they are equipped to. • Consumable Items may be sold for 1 Gold regardless of their Loot Level. Any Consumables not equipped on an Adventurer or not sold during a Story Round are discarded at the end of the Shop and Train. • For Monster Loot sale price, See Unlocking Item Upgrades Pg. 28 • Accessories may be sold as if they were an Item from your current Loot LVL or for the gold cost printed on their card, whichever is lower. • After being sold, Unique Items are removed from the Adventure. • Story Items may never be sold.

candidates.sourceText: The Long Sword has the DOUBLE Tag, and can be equipped using either its front or back side. The back side is 2-Handed while the front side is 1-Handed. This provides the player using a Long Sword with a lot of different options depending on their play style.
candidates.proposalText: A Espada Longa tem Tag DOUBLE e pode ser equipada por qualquer uma das faces. A face traseira usa duas Mãos; a frontal, uma. Assim, quem usa uma Espada Longa tem muitas opções, conforme seu estilo de jogo.

candidates.sourceText: Types
candidates.proposalText: Tipos
candidates.proposalMarkup: Tipos

candidates.sourceText: Weapons : These cards augment an Adventurer’s Combat Dice Pool and are used to make Attacks. Armor : These cards grant Armor to Adventurers and can keep them alive during Encounters. Cores : These magical devices augment an Adventurer’s Ability to avoid damage. Cores typically increase an Adventurer’s Defense Value. Consumables : These Items can be used once before they are discarded. Relics : Relics provide many various benefits while equipped. Accessories : These cards further augment an Adventurer's Ability to avoid damage but also have unique properties beyond just that.
candidates.proposalText:
Armas: Ampliam a reserva de Dados de Combate do Aventureiro e são usadas para atacar.
Armadura: Concede Armadura e ajuda a manter Aventureiros vivos durante Encontros.
Núcleos: Dispositivos mágicos que ajudam a evitar dano e costumam aumentar o Valor de Defesa.
Consumíveis: Podem ser usados uma vez antes de serem descartados.
Relíquias: Oferecem vários benefícios enquanto equipadas.
Acessórios: Também ajudam a evitar dano e têm outras propriedades únicas.

candidates.sourceText: The Deflection Core does not have the DOUBLE Tag. This means that it can only be equipped using its front side, (unless it was Flipped earlier.) The front side represents the Core's Ability to pass a Conviction Check as being unused. Once an Adventurer decides to use the Ability, the Item will Flip.
candidates.proposalText: O Núcleo de Deflexão não tem Tag DOUBLE; só pode ser equipado pela face frontal, salvo se já tiver sido Virado. A face frontal indica que a Habilidade de passar em um Teste de Convicção ainda não foi usada. Ao usar essa Habilidade, o Aventureiro vira o Item.

technicalExceptions.sourceText: • Item Upgrades grant 5 extra Gold per Item Upgrade equipped. Item Upgrades cannot be sold without also selling the Item they are equipped to. • Consumable Items may be sold for 1 Gold regardless of their Loot Level. Any Consumables not equipped on an Adventurer or not sold during a Story Round are discarded at the end of the Shop and Train. • For Monster Loot sale price, See Unlocking Item Upgrades Pg. 28 • Accessories may be sold as if they were an Item from your current Loot LVL or for the gold cost printed on their card, whichever is lower. • After being sold, Unique Items are removed from the Adventure. • Story Items may never be sold.
technicalExceptions.proposedText:
• Cada Aprimoramento de Item equipado concede 5 de Ouro extra. Para vendê-lo, também é preciso vender o Item ao qual está ligado.
• Consumíveis valem 1 de Ouro, qualquer que seja seu Nível de Saque. Os que não estiverem equipados em um Aventureiro ou não forem vendidos durante a Rodada de História são descartados ao fim de Comprar e Treinar.
• Saque de Monstro: veja Desbloquear Aprimoramentos de Item, p. 28.
• Acessórios são vendidos pelo preço de um Item do Nível de Saque atual ou pelo custo impresso na carta, o que for menor.
• Itens Únicos vendidos são removidos da Aventura.
• Itens de História nunca podem ser vendidos.
